import numpy as np
from numpy.linalg import lstsq
one=np.ones_like(T)
Tb={'1':one,'lnT':np.log(T),'1/T':1/T,'T':T}
def test(tk,ek):
    X=np.column_stack([Tb[a]*{'1':one,'sqe':np.sqrt(eps),'e':eps,'e2':eps**2,'lne':np.log(eps)}[b] for a in tk for b in ek])
    c,_,_,_=lstsq(X,sigma,rcond=None); r=sigma-X@c
    return np.mean(r**2)/np.var(sigma), np.round(c,4)
